snippet.title: Mars First Logistics | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Two years of research and development are about to pay off, with Shape Shop’s Mars First Logistics cooked and ready to leave Early Access on September 26th! Build physically simulated rovers and transport awkwardly shaped cargo across the surface of Mars. Earn funds, unlock new parts, and use your ingenuity to help the martians establish a new home. Playable solo or in online co-op!

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532200/Mars_First_Logistics/

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration  

#frostygamesfest #gaming #indiegames #madeinanz
